title: Multi-omic machine learning predictor of breast cancer therapy response
summary: ML integration of clinical, pathology, genomic and transcriptomic features from 168 pre-treatment biopsies predicted pathology response to chemotherapy with or without HER2-targeted therapy.

source_review.scope: Europe PMC metadata and abstract only; Methods not read.

evidence.tested: Retrospective cohort; external validation not assessed from the abstract.
